comments_and_explainations.stop_method: can be set to 'end_time' 'nrphotos' or 'either'. If the settings is set to either the script ends at what is being reached first
comments_and_explainations.save_all_images: if set to true, two folders will be made, one with all pictures which will be saved in either condition and one called DEL for the images which will be deleted if this settings is set to False. If the settings is set to false, only images which differ from former will be stored
comments_and_explainations.noise_threshold: Defines the minimum pixel value difference (0-255) to be considered as change. Higher values reduce sensitivity to small changes but may miss subtle movements.
comments_and_explainations.contour_area_threshold: Minimum size (in pixels) of a connected area of changed pixels to be considered significant. This settings helps to filter out very small or insignificant changes.
comments_and_explainations.change_percentage: min_change_percentage and max_change_percentage define the acceptable range of image change (as a percentage of total pixels) for saving an image. Changes outside this range are either too small or too large to be of interest.
